verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Fellow acting as an MCP *server* — exposing its own meeting data/tools so external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) can consume them — not Fellow acting as an MCP *client* that plugs into other MCP servers to use their tools. There is no evidence Fellow's own AI assistant ('Ask Fellow') can connect to or use tools from third-party MCP servers.
